text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I think we need some special things for
the room.
You know, to make it really
groovy!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Time for some redecorating then! What
would
really liven up this joint?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
We should make it just like the castle
interior
from Princess Fighter, so in other
words, striking
and elegant!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's not forget about practicality as
well!
Something that could completely
transform an
ordinary ol' dorm room...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If we're going for a complete makeover,
then I
think we need to focus on the
floor and walls. The
curtains and carpet
might be a start!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The carpet, huh? Oh, that reminds me
that I've
always wanted a sumo ring
carpet for my room! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A sumo ring? Admiring one's own culture
is
another way to go global, so I get ya!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mhmm, and I could also practice sumo in
my very
own room!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Spectacular! As a princess, training is
also
important. I think I'll take that idea
as well!
